description.en: Loads and runs a story/quest event script by numeric ID (from data/script/event/ev<id>.nutb), waiting for it to load, then driving its Event coroutine (and the match camera controller, via sysCamCtrlStep) to completion frame by frame.
Numeric event ID, used to build the event script's file path.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

examples.case: Dispatching to the right event runner depending on the NPC's event type (real usage, from ie4_ev_sub_std.nut)
